riskFlags.title: Termination on seven days' notice
riskFlags.says: The Licensor can end the licence at any time on seven days' written notice.
riskFlags.judgment: No reason is needed, and no refund of the fee is stated for the rest of the month.
sourceSentences: 5. The Licensor may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving the Licensee seven days' notice in writing.
riskFlags.counterOffer: 5. The Licensor is entitled to terminate this Agreement only at the end of the period of eleven months.

riskFlags.title: Fee due by the fifth
riskFlags.says: The Licensee pays Rs. 18,000 by the fifth day of each month.
riskFlags.judgment: A licensor typically allows a longer grace period.
sourceSentences: 2. The Licensee shall pay a licence fee of Rs. 18,000 per month to the Licensor on or before the fifth day of each month.
riskFlags.counterOffer: 2. The Licensee shall pay a licence fee of Rs. 18,000 per month to the Licensor on or before the fifth day of each month for that month.

riskFlags.title: Deposit refund
riskFlags.says: The deposit of Rs. 54,000 is refunded within 30 days of the end of the licence.
sourceSentences: 3. The Licensee shall deposit Rs. 54,000 with the Licensor as a security deposit, which the Licensor shall refund at the end of the licence.
riskFlags.counterOffer: 3. The Licensee shall deposit Rs. 54,000 with the Licensor as a security deposit, which the Licensor shall refund in full on the last day of the licence.

riskFlags.title: Uncapped indemnity
riskFlags.says: The Licensee indemnifies the Licensor against all claims arising from the use of the office.
riskFlags.judgment: No cap on the indemnity appears in the document.
sourceSentences: The Licensee shall indemnify the Licensor against all claims arising from the use of the office.
riskFlags.counterOffer: 4.1 The Licensee shall indemnify the Licensor against claims arising from the Licensee's use of the office, up to the amount of the security deposit.
